Aqua Kyoto Paris.notes: Accounts: GA4 property 478459011; Meta act_1090963963133236 (returns as 'Aqua Kyoto - Paris'); Google Ads customer 3987846746 (no manager_id needed). CURRENCY: Google Ads cost is native EUR, no conversion applied. Meta spend is native EUR. Meta daily rows sum exactly to the API period summaries (TY 8040.42, LY 3811.23). GAPS, all in last year and all verified as genuine no-delivery days rather than failed pulls: Meta returned no row for 2025-09-28 (affects LY W39); Google returned no row for 2025-10-05 (affects LY W40) or for 2025-10-06, 2025-10-07 and 2025-10-08 (affects LY W41). The Google gap was re-queried with impressions and clicks selected and still returned no rows for those dates, so the account did not serve. LY W41 therefore carries 4 of 7 days of Google spend; the figure is what the account actually spent, not an estimate. Both 2026 ranges returned all 35 days on both platforms. SESSIONS: GA4 metric 'sessions', one ranged call per year with a daily breakdown, summed into weeks. OCTOBER 2025 IS A LAUNCH BURST, NOT AN ERROR: 8 to 12 Oct 2025 carried 26,357 sessions, which is 88% of LY W41's 29,974, peaking at 9,102 on 9 Oct. The same days carried 2,653 and 3,004 brand impressions. The large year on year falls in LY W41 sessions and brand are that burst dropping out. The property launched in late 2025, so LY W37 to W40 are early-life figures on a rising base and are not a stable comparison either. BRAND: Search Console impressions on https://aquakyoto.fr/, Brand Demand Index method (name-search impressions), server-side query filter includingRegex 'aqua|acqua|asua|auqa|awua|aquq', which is the aqua root plus the misspellings that actually appear in the data (asua kyoto, acqua kyoto, auqa kyoto, awua kyoto, aquq kyoto) and which also picks up the 'aqua tokyo' mishearing. Bare 'kyoto ...' queries with no aqua root were excluded as generic rather than name searches. LONDON INTENT ON THE .fr PROPERTY: I kept the Brand Demand Index method and did NOT exclude it, because it is negligible and symmetric. Across the whole 35-day window the .fr property served 38 brand-matching London-intent impressions in 2026 (29 of them 'aqua kyoto london', 0 clicks) and 45 in 2025, under 0.2% of brand impressions in either year. Excluding it would not move any weekly figure. Queries Google anonymises or holds below threshold are excluded, so brand is a floor, equally in both years. TY W40 brand is genuinely spiky: 1,762 impressions on 2 Oct 2026 and 1,246 on 3 Oct against a ~600 baseline. Paris has no Google local action rows in either year; local actions were not pulled, per the brief, and no zero has been introduced for them.
